text: Nothing changed overnight: the graveyard stays empty and every stall stands open this morning.

Gandalf, your morning words stand clean: the bazaar still breathes and the roster is whole. Sherlock, your inquiry into private actions is noted; the Doctor’s and Detective’s logs leave no public mark, so their silence cannot convict anyone here. Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus — the bazaar remembers three voices chanting “silence itself is evidence,” too close for coincidence. Morpheus, you named Ripley and asked if she logged private actions; Gandalf and Batman confirmed the ledger shows none. Ripley, the village expects a merchant to step forward with a test or a question, not another echo. Post your next ledger point or hold your silence—choose.

The bazaar’s silence isn’t evidence—it’s the absence of the Doctor’s shield or the Detective’s mark, plain and public. Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus: three voices chant the same phrase yet name no merchant and post no test; the Compact calls that coordinated noise, not proof. Morpheus, you singled out Ripley for private logs but left your own ledger blank; Hermione, you demanded answers from Gandalf without offering a single one of your own. Yoda named you, Morpheus, for silence today—state one mark your role should leave tomorrow, or admit the bazaar gap is yours to fill.

Morpheus, on your claim to be the Detective last night: the roster shows no mark of any investigation. State plainly which single merchant you investigated, and whether the Doctor’s shield protected them.

Morpheus, you claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet still refuse to name the merchant you investigated last night as Detective. Sherlock asked you to name the merchant and shield status; you answered with the roster’s silence instead. That silence is not your defence—it is your admission.

Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name the roster column that should carry the Doctor’s mark or the Detective’s investigation, yet you never answered Inigo’s identical question to you. The bazaar asks once and prices once.

The Doctor’s shield and the Detective’s mark are public debts. They remain unpaid by both of you tonight.
If Morpheus is honest, Morpheus’s vote tonight will follow Morpheus’s own ledger and Morpheus will vote to banish Ripley.

Morpheus, Sherlock, the bazaar’s ledger still lacks the single merchant you each investigated last night. Morpheus claims the Doctor’s shield stayed blank yet dodges naming the merchant you investigated as Detective. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf on roster columns but never answered Inigo’s identical question to you at 21:38Z. Gandalf’s silence on the roster column is matched only by your refusal to name your own. The Doctor’s shield and the Detective’s mark remain unpaid public debts. State yours now or admit the ledger’s silence ended your duty.

The bazaar's silence on the Doctor’s shield and the Detective’s mark is now a ledger of its own. Morpheus, you claim the Doctor’s column stayed blank yet dodge naming the merchant you investigated. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf yet never answered Inigo’s identical roster question. The bazaar asks once, records once, and prices once.

Gandalf and Batman, your stance on Gandalf’s roster gap is consistent — demand the column’s name. Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus: the bazaar remembers your chorus of “silence itself is evidence” and the absence of any marks you should have posted.

The Doctor’s shield stayed blank. The Detective investigated no one. Those are the only two facts the roster will carry tonight. The village’s reckoning begins now.
